title: Boiler Inspection Work Order Form
subtitle: Boiler Inspection: connects authorized scope to results.
description: Boiler Inspection Work Order Form covers boiler, burner, fuel train, controls, venting, water system, and served loop. The facility boiler coordinator records Boiler Inspection authorized tasks, materials, results, and changes. Boiler Inspection Work Order Form keeps Boiler Inspection exceptions visible until the facility boiler coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Boiler Inspection Work Order Form at boiler room, fuel entry, flue route, and served mechanical system. Document boiler, burner, fuel train, controls, venting, water system, and served loop identity before Boiler Inspection begins. Compare boiler, burner, fuel train, controls, venting, water system, and served loop findings with stated Boiler Inspection criteria; route unresolved Boiler Inspection issues to qualified boiler or combustion-system reviewer. For Boiler Inspection Work Order Form, confirm requirements for Boiler Inspection. Ask qualified boiler or combustion-system reviewer to review Boiler Inspection conditions beyond the facility boiler coordinator's role.

sections.title: Facility work-order scope review
sections.guidance: Bind Boiler Inspection to party, worker, site, and service window.

blocks.guidance: Use the Boiler Inspection identifier printed on boiler, burner, fuel train, controls, venting, water system, and served loop or its linked source record.

sections.title: Authorized work observations and evidence
sections.guidance: Record authorized Boiler Inspection activity; separate proposed, declined, deferred, or new Boiler Inspection scope.

blocks.label: Boiler Inspection work and verification points
items: Visible vessel, piping, valve, pump, and leak condition
Burner, flame, fuel-train, and ignition observation
Vent, draft, combustion-air, and room condition
Pressure, temperature, level, and makeup-water indication
Limit, cutoff, relief, alarm, and control response
Startup, operating, shutdown, and lockout sequence
blocks.guidance: Use each Boiler Inspection check to prompt documented boiler, burner, fuel train, controls, venting, water system, and served loop execution; enter its actual Boiler Inspection result in the table.

sections.title: Work exception and scope changes
sections.guidance: Stop Boiler Inspection at any scope or cost limit; honor facility boiler coordinator access and safety boundaries.

blocks.label: Do not proceed without control
blocks.guidance: Stop normal processing when a fuel, combustion, pressure-boundary, venting, or required safety-control concern remains. Protect boiler, burner, fuel train, controls, venting, water system, and served loop; document the Boiler Inspection notification and await qualified boiler or combustion-system reviewer direction.

blocks.label: Conditions requiring stop or renewed authorization
items: Low-water, limit, relief, or cutoff failure
Unsafe pressure, temperature, venting, or vessel condition
Test requires authority or shutdown not available
blocks.guidance: For Boiler Inspection, identify affected boiler, burner, fuel train, controls, venting, water system, and served loop scope; ask facility boiler coordinator to document the Boiler Inspection immediate control before continuing.
